title: Networking is composed from specialist transport and evidence authorities
summary: Network management separates logical service transport, socket/provider capability, XTP route authority, multicast membership, observed path evidence and protocol-specific instrumentation. Management only discovers and composes these specialists.
invariants: Configured routes, observed connectivity, transport capabilities and derived health are different facts.
XTP owns XTP route/path selection and wire scheduling semantics; Management must not reproduce them.
Socket Provider owns transport acquisition/isolation; logical services request capability rather than hard-code network mechanics.
NORM/IP multicast/XTP multicast remain native provider/address objects and are not flattened to generic host:port strings.
Ambiguous field results such as NO_RESPONSE_OR_FILTERED must stay ambiguous until an authority provides causal evidence.
Current Library Network Transport Intentions dev3 accepts provider-specific future address shapes by querying optional methods instead of assuming XTP-only fields.

provenance.claim: Current Library network intention head observed during reconciliation.
Records current transport estate including Socket Provider dev16, XTP dev19, NORM dev3 and socket telemetry projected to Instrumentation Mesh.
